API ReferenceZscaler Client Connector APIPublic API ControllerRemoves machine tunnel devices
Removes machine tunnel devices
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zcc/papi/public/v1/removeMachineTunnel

Remove machine tunnel devices.

Note: For the parameters described below, you can specify either hostName or machineToken but not both.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
hostName
string

Comma-separated list of hostnames for the device.

machineToken
string

Machine token.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
hostNames
string[]
machineToken
string
Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
429

OK

Schema
Example (auto)
